specNotes: OpenRTB2.6 device.sua and Bid.mtype declare version-specific fields in both sides. Banner placement retains the IAB required media object.

The product inpage-push dialect documents bid.ext.title/description/image/icon/url/cta and explicitly limits itself to response validation. Its widget_id/zone_id inpage signal is documented by the product feed-format detector, but is not currently traversed under an OpenRTB Imp.
No third-party vendor is claimed to support this2.6shape. This tests the product-owned extension contract within an IAB2.6envelope.
